summary: Refreshes a timer/standings UI list. With a2 non-zero, forces a full rebuild: StateCleanupNotification clears list state, then for each grid slot v11 = 1..104 the vehicle whose position field (vehicle + 16480) equals v11 is located in dword_7C54F0; non-retired vehicles (vehicle + 13000 != -1) get a display string via FTIMTimerBitmapSelector, a menu item created by UIMenuItemCreator with the vehicle number (vehicle + 18580) formatted as '%d' by StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, and named via UIItemNameSetter. With a2 zero, iterates slots v4 = 0..103 incrementally, finding the vehicle whose position field minus 1 equals v4; when present and not retired it compares the existing item name (UIItemTextAccessor) against a freshly built string and updates it via sub_588410 when unchanged, or jumps to the full rebuild path on a missing item or mismatch. Returns the last computed result (0 on clean completion).

operations.description: Initialize the local display buffer v20 with the byte_5EA438 seed byte and zero the remainder.
Branch on a2: non-zero selects the full rebuild path, zero selects the incremental text-update path.
StateCleanupNotification(this) clears UI list state before the rebuild.
Read the vehicle count dword_5C329C as the search bound v8.
For each slot v11 = 1..104, scan dword_7C54F0[0..v8) for a vehicle whose position field (vehicle + 16480) equals v11; return early when no match exists.
Skip the vehicle when its slot-state field at vehicle + 13000 equals -1.
FTIMTimerBitmapSelector(this, vehicle_index, byte_7CD718, v20) composes the display string for the vehicle position.
Format the vehicle number field (vehicle + 18580) as '%d' into the local buffer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.
UIMenuItemCreator(byte_7CD718, 0, 0, &v14, 0) creates a new UI menu item.
UIItemNameSetter(v9, v20) assigns the display string as the name of the item at index v9; the item index increments per created item.

Incremental path: for each slot v4 = 0..103 find the vehicle in dword_7C54F0 whose position field minus 1 equals v4; when none exists or the vehicle is retired, fetch the existing item via UIListItemByIndex(v4).

For active vehicles, compare the existing item name (UIItemTextAccessor(v4)) against the string freshly built by FTIMTimerBitmapSelector; on a missing item or a mismatch, jump to the full rebuild path (LABEL_16).
When the existing text matches, update the item text with sub_588410(v20, v13).
Return the last computed result; a non-zero result routes control back to the full rebuild path.

clean_pseudocode: find vehicle with position == slot; if none, return;
